Summary: 
According to Statcounter data, Google Chrome has become the most popular browser in history, with a global market share of 71.77% across all platforms—including desktops, laptops, smartphones, and tablets—marking its highest-ever popularity. Apple's Safari ranks second with 13.9%, primarily used by iPhone owners. Microsoft Edge follows with 4.67%, Mozilla Firefox with 2.17%, Samsung Internet with 1.86%, and Opera with 1.74%. Despite past antitrust concerns and issues such as hidden malicious extensions and the integration of AI features directly into the browser, users continue to favor Chrome. Google has recently introduced AI-powered features like search suggestions and content generation. Chrome has led the browser market for over a decade, with its market share continuing to grow, and it is regularly updated to protect users from malicious sites and extensions.

Title: Chrome Yüzde 70 Pazar Payı ile Temmuz 2025'te Yine Zirveyi Bırakmadı

Summary: 
According to Statcounter's July 2025 data, Google Chrome has solidified its position as the world's most popular browser with a market share of approximately 70%. Last month, Chrome reached a near-record high of 69.98% market share, a 3.09-point increase. Microsoft Edge, in second place, has seen a significant decline in user base, dropping from 13.06% to 11.8% in July 2025. Microsoft is attempting to attract users with its new Copilot Mode, which includes features such as smart page summaries, multi-tab context, and more, but users are not willing to grant access to Microsoft's AI to its browsers. It will be interesting to see how the market reacts to this new idea. Google is also working on developing more AI-powered experiences for Chrome, taking into account the potential threat of new-generation browsers like Perplexity's Comet. Other browsers have also seen a decline in market share. Apple's Safari is in third place with 6.51% (-1.83 points), Firefox is in fourth with 5.32% (-0.52 points), and Opera is in fifth with 2.2% (-0.43 points). The mobile market also shows a similar trend, with Google Chrome at 67.32% market share, Safari at 22.42%, and Samsung Internet at 3.5%.

Title: Google Chrome, il browser più utilizzato negli ultimi tempi

Summary: 
Google Chrome remains the most widely used web browser globally, with StatCounter reporting a 71.77% market share in September 2025, confirming its continued dominance since surpassing Internet Explorer in 2012. The browser's success is attributed to its seamless integration with Google services and the introduction of generative AI features that have enhanced search speed and functionality. Apple's Safari holds the second position with a stable 14% global market share, primarily due to its default installation on Apple devices. Microsoft Edge, despite ongoing innovations, has failed to gain significant traction, remaining below 5% market share. The dominance of Chrome has raised concerns about monopolistic practices, prompting the U.S. Department of Justice to label Google’s business strategies as anti-competitive. In response, Google has shared data to support other browsers, though future regulatory actions may shape the browser landscape.
